slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: CLI first
slides.subtitle: Even if the final agent is a Telegram bot.

slides.title: The temptation
slides.body: The assignment says Telegram bot, so it is tempting to start with Telegram.

slides.title: Start smaller
slides.body: Use a terminal app to debug the user question, tool calls, data fetches, and final answer.

slides.title: What to inspect
slides.body: Check whether the agent calls tools, avoids raw data dumps, gives useful analysis, and respects safety rules.

slides.title: Then wrap it
slides.body: After the core loop works, Telegram becomes an interface problem instead of an agent-debugging problem.
